_about: Numeric inputs for visualizations in src/components/sections/DatasetPipelineViz.svelte. The `validatedSpeedupHistogram` section is derivable from harbor_runs once that table is populated; the demo arrays used elsewhere in the pipeline animation (sample PRs, neighbor SHAs, agent log) are intentionally inline since they are illustrative narrative content rather than measurements.

validatedSpeedupHistogram._description: Step 10 (validate_and_publish) — histogram comparing base-only speedups against expert-patch speedups across 10 bins spanning ~1x to ~6x. Used to visualize the speedup gate at MIN_SPEEDUP_GATE=1.05x.
validatedSpeedupHistogram._sql: WITH bins AS (SELECT generate_series(0, 9) AS bin), runs AS (SELECT max_speedup, agent_name='oracle' AS is_expert FROM harbor_runs WHERE status='success') SELECT b.bin, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT r.is_expert) AS base_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.is_expert) AS expert_count FROM bins b LEFT JOIN runs r ON r.max_speedup >= 1 + b.bin*0.5 AND r.max_speedup < 1 + (b.bin+1)*0.5 GROUP BY b.bin ORDER BY b.bin;
